name: What is rooter service and when is it needed?

mainEntity.name: What is rooter service and when is it needed?

acceptedAnswer.text: Rooter service, also known as drain cleaning or snaking, is a method of clearing blockages and obstructions from plumbing lines using a specialized machine with a rotating cable and cutter head. It is typically needed when you experience slow drains, recurring clogs, gurgling sounds from pipes, or unpleasant odors indicating a significant blockage. For homes in the Las Vegas area, common culprits include grease buildup, hair, soap scum, and tree roots infiltrating older sewer lines, which can become a more significant issue if not addressed promptly.
acceptedAnswer.description: Rooter service clears plumbing blockages with a special machine and is needed for slow drains, recurring clogs, or foul odors.
